sync.title: Export folder
sync.intro: Open this page on the shop PC, in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome, and connect the folder your stock software exports to. While the page is open (minimised is fine) it checks the folder every 15 minutes and sends the newest stock file to PPI. PPI only reads that one folder and changes nothing on the PC.

sync.install_intro: Install PPI as an app, then let it start with Windows, so the folder is checked even after a restart.

sync.install_manual: No button? In Edge: menu (⋯) → Apps → Install this site as an app. In Chrome: menu (⋮) → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.
sync.autostart_title: Open PPI automatically when Windows starts:
sync.autostart_1: Start → All apps → right-click “PPI” → More → Open file location.
sync.autostart_2: Select the “PPI” shortcut and copy it (Ctrl+C).
sync.autostart_3: Press Windows+R, type shell:startup and press Enter.
sync.autostart_4: Paste the shortcut into the folder that opens (Ctrl+V).

privacy_assistant.title: Privacy in the shop assistant
privacy_assistant.draft: Draft text – the final wording is being prepared.
privacy_assistant.what: If the shop has the Pro plan, every conversation with its assistant is stored: your messages, the assistant's answers with the items it showed you (name, price and availability at that moment) and the files you send. Location data (GPS) is removed from photos. Access keys are never stored in the conversation.
privacy_assistant.who: Only the owners of this shop, in My shop. Other shops and visitors cannot see it.
privacy_assistant.time: A conversation ends after 30 minutes without a message or when you close the chat. The shop keeps it until it deletes it, or for 30, 90 or 365 days if it set a limit; then it is deleted with its files.
privacy_assistant.delete: While the chat is open, you can delete the conversation and files with “Delete my conversation”. Later, please ask the shop directly.
privacy_assistant.external: When Cacaduu's main search finds too little, it also asks other services: shops nearby from OpenStreetMap (and Google Maps, when switched on) and offers on larger shops' websites (Anthropic's web search). It sends them only the product and the town from your question, nothing else about you. We never find out your location.
privacy_assistant.external_partners: “Partners” offers come from partner shops' product feeds, which Cacaduu reads on its own server. Nothing about you is sent to partners when you search; only you open a partner's link. Affiliate links are marked “partner link” and never change the order of the results.
privacy_assistant.external_todo: TODO (legal text): the services the main search sends the product and the town to – OpenStreetMap Foundation (Nominatim, Overpass API), Google (Places API, when switched on), Anthropic (Claude and its web search).
privacy_assistant.booking: When you book a time through the assistant, the shop receives your name, mobile number and, if given, e-mail, address and note, and the time you agreed. We send an SMS with a code to your mobile (valid for 10 minutes); the code is not stored. The booking is kept for the shop as a contact and – if the shop connected its Google Calendar – as an event in its calendar. If the shop switches it on, you get a reminder SMS the day before. Only the shop's owners see your data. SMS are sent through an SMS provider (Brevo, or Twilio), which receives only the number and the text of the message.
privacy_assistant.callback: If the assistant cannot answer, you can leave the shop a phone number or e-mail (and a name). The shop keeps them as a contact together with this conversation and gets an e-mail that you are waiting for an answer (without your number or address). It replies by SMS or e-mail. The time you agreed is kept too. You can ask the shop directly to delete the contact.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draft: Draft. TODO: Cacaduu's final (legally checked) text replaces this draft – the texts are in privacy.* in the three message files.
privacy.who: Cacaduu PPI runs the website on which local shops publish their stock, opening hours and news. TODO: the operator's name, address, company ID, contact.
privacy.visitors: The pages use no advertising or tracking scripts and never ask for your location. Search sends only the words you type. Details about a shop's AI assistant are on the assistant privacy page. A YouTube video loads only after a tap on ▶ (via youtube-nocookie.com); until then nothing loads from YouTube. Page speed and visit counts are measured with Vercel Speed Insights and Web Analytics: no cookies, no ads, no location and nothing that could identify a visitor.
privacy.owners: We keep the account's e-mail and password (the password only as a hash), the shop's details and the files the owner uploads. TODO: retention, rights.
privacy.facebook: When a shop owner connects their Facebook Page, Cacaduu gets access to that Page (permissions pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts). From the Page we download only its own posts: text, time, link, photos (stored as WebP), shared links and the pictures of videos with a link. We never download comments, reactions or other people's names. The Page's access token is stored only encrypted and is deleted with "Disconnect". We publish on Facebook only an article the owner explicitly publishes with "Web + Facebook". The public pages have no Facebook scripts, pixels or embedded elements.

privacy.deletion_step2: Delete downloaded posts in the list of articles with "Delete" (their photos are deleted too). Delete the whole shop with its data in My shop → Delete shop.

inventory_api.privacy_text: Your browser sends the key straight to a Cacaduu function, which checks it first and stores it only encrypted. We read only products from the software: code, name, EAN, brand, quantity, selling price, currency, description and category. We do not ask for purchase prices, suppliers or margins; if the software sends them, we drop them before storing. We never change the software's data. “Disconnect” deletes the key at once.
